data.abstract: The Coast Guard will enforce a safety zone for the City of Richland Lighted Boat Parade Fireworks on December 5, 2026, to provide for the safety of life on navigable waters during a fireworks display. Our regulation for the fireworks display within the Northwest Coast Guard District designates safety zones and identifies approximate dates for these events.
